versions.content: Clear: If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is called with TrcvWakeupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_CLEAR, then a stored wakeup event is cleared on the addressed network. Clearing of wakeup events have to be used when the wake up notification is disabled to clear all stored wake up events under control of the higher layer.
